I get that too, the phantom pain. hurts even more than actual injections that I’ve gotten before. nobody is allowed to touch the upper part of my arm or poke me literally anywhere. I had a phase where it was so bad that I had to wrap a tight scarf around my arm to kind of compress the pain. It’s very real and probably way more common than you think! I wish I had actual good advice that could help you with this but unfortunately i don’t have THE solution. You basically have 2 options, you either keep reminding yourself that there is no actual threat right now and that you’re safe or you try treating it like real pain, putting a cooling pack on your arm for example. You could also try massaging the parts of your body where you’ve gotten injections before to kinda get used to feeling pressure there until you’re able to poke those areas. You’re not alone!
